title: Actress Dana Whitfield checks into Malibu rehab facility
text: Actress Dana Whitfield checked into a rehabilitation facility in Malibu on Thursday, her publicist confirmed. The 34-year-old star of the series Harbor Lights entered the Oceanview Recovery Center after what her representative described as an exhausting year of filming. Whitfield is expected to remain at the facility for at least 30 days.

title: Harbor Lights star enters treatment center
text: Dana Whitfield, best known for her role on Harbor Lights, has entered a treatment center on the California coast, sources close to the actress said Friday. Whitfield was admitted to Oceanview Recovery Center in Malibu on Thursday evening. Her team asked for privacy while she focuses on her health.

title: Singer Marcus Vane begins rehab stay in Arizona
text: Singer Marcus Vane has begun a stay at a rehabilitation clinic near Tucson, Arizona, his manager announced on Friday. Vane, 41, canceled the remaining dates of his summer tour before entering the Desert Springs clinic earlier this week. The Grammy-nominated musician said in a statement that he wanted to address his struggles before returning to the stage.

title: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes northern Chile
text: A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck northern Chile on Tuesday morning, shaking buildings in the port city of Iquique and knocking out power in several districts. Chile's national emergency office reported nine injuries and damage to an older section of the city's hospital. The quake hit at 7:42 a.m. local time, with an epicenter about 60 kilometers inland.

title: Chile assesses damage after Tuesday's quake near Iquique
text: Emergency crews in northern Chile continued to assess damage on Wednesday, a day after a 6.4-magnitude earthquake rattled the region around Iquique. Officials confirmed that nine people were injured when the quake struck Tuesday morning. President Camila Reyes toured the damaged hospital wing and promised funds for repairs. Schools in the port city remained closed as inspections continued.

title: Strong earthquake shakes northern Japan, no tsunami risk
text: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck off the coast of Hokkaido in northern Japan on Friday evening, the Japan Meteorological Agency said. The agency reported no risk of a tsunami. Trains in the city of Kushiro were briefly halted for track inspections, and two people suffered minor injuries from falling objects. The quake was centered about 40 kilometers offshore at a depth of 50 kilometers.

title: Veltron chief executive resigns after board dispute
text: Rajan Mehta resigned as chief executive of software maker Veltron on Monday, following a months-long dispute with the company's board over acquisition strategy. Mehta, who led the Austin-based firm for eight years, will be replaced on an interim basis by chief financial officer Sandra Okafor. Veltron shares fell three percent on the news.

title: After Mehta's exit, Veltron faces questions about its direction
text: The resignation of Veltron CEO Rajan Mehta on Monday has left analysts questioning the software company's next move. Mehta stepped down after clashing with directors over a proposed acquisition of a European cloud firm. Interim chief Sandra Okafor told employees at the Austin headquarters on Tuesday that the company's product roadmap would not change.

title: Halcyon Air CEO steps down amid restructuring
text: Halcyon Air chief executive Beatriz Fonseca stepped down on Monday as the struggling carrier announced a broad restructuring plan. Fonseca, who had led the Lisbon-based airline since 2016, said the company needed new leadership for its next phase. The board named veteran industry executive Tomas Ruiz as her successor, effective December 1.

title: Wildfire forces evacuations in Colorado foothills
text: A fast-moving wildfire in the foothills west of Boulder, Colorado, forced the evacuation of roughly 2,000 residents on Sunday afternoon. The Pine Gulch fire, driven by gusty winds, burned an estimated 1,400 acres within hours of igniting. Firefighters from three counties worked overnight to protect homes along Sunshine Canyon, and no injuries were reported.
